newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Hyundai to make announcement on Scotland plant.
newsitem.headline: Hyundai to make announcement on Scotland plant.

text.p: Hyundai Electronics Industries Co Ltd, a unit of South Korea's Hyundai Group said on Tuesday it will make an announcement on Tuesday regarding a semiconductor plant in Scotland.
The announcement will be made at 4 p.m. local time (0700 GMT) in South Korea, and simultaneously in Britain, a spokesman said. He declined to give any details on the content of the announcement.
The company said in July it planned to build a plant in a European country to make 64-megabit dynamic random access memory (DRAM) chips.
British media reports at the time said Hyundai may be planning a one billion sterling ($1.56 billion) microchip factory in Scotland.

In July, South Korea's LG Group signed a 1.7 billion sterling ($2.65 billion) contract to make semiconductors and electronic goods in Wales. It was the biggest single overseas investment in Europe from outside the region.
